newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Bank to start yuan business on Mar 27.
newsitem.headline: HK Bank to start yuan business on Mar 27.

text.p: Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corp Ltd said on Wednesday it would start to conduct Chinese yuan business in its Shanghai branch in Pudong from March 27.

Under the provisional regulations governing yuan business by foreign banks, Hongkong Bank said it is permitted to provide a range of yuan services including deposits, loans, issuance of guarantees and payment settlement.
Customers approved by the regulations are foreign invested enterprises and foreign residents of Shanghai, including those of Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan, it said in a statement.
In addition to the Pudong branch, Hongkong Bank, a unit of HSBC Holdings Plc, has five branches and four representative offices in China.
